propositions: Planning currently mixes snapshot reads, binding lifecycle decisions, and global mode caps without separating pure plan computation from side effects.
Without immutable per-ticket plans, retry recovery can recompute against different observations and global filters cannot be safely applied after decision-bearing work.

A pure planner must consume local/remote snapshots, binding view, mode, selection/filter, and caps without I/O, emitting immutable TicketPlan values containing Mutations, versioned lifecycle intents, dependencies, diagnostics, disposition, and observation identity.
Selection, filtering, mode caps, and global safety limits must execute before any lifecycle intent or remote operation becomes eligible.
Create/link and hierarchy prerequisites must be encoded as explicit inter-ticket dependencies in plans, blocking work with deferred disposition rather than out-of-order mutations.
Existing mutation serialization, dry-run preview bytes, and stored ticket/binding formats must remain compatible while adding an optional versioned lifecycle-intent section.
